description: Defines classes and methods for managing simple index files in disk cache, including serialization, deserialization, loading, and writing index data to disk.

classes.name: SimpleIndexFile
classes.description: Manages reading and writing of index files for disk cache, including serialization, deserialization, and disk operations.

classes.name: SimpleIndexFile::IndexMetadata
classes.description: Holds metadata about the index, including reason for write, entry count, and versioning info.

methods.name: LoadIndexEntries
methods.description: Loads index entries from disk based on current cache context.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes index metadata and entries into a pickle for disk storage.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes index data from raw bytes into index entries.
